findings.title: Scorer unavailable: application readiness fails
findings.detail: GET /health/ready returns 503 ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE. GET /api/v1/models/current returns artifact_ready=false and scoring_available=false for forest-independent-2025-v2. Saved scores are still readable; they do not demonstrate that new inference works. Confirm the deployed assets, MODEL_DIR, checksum/dependency contract, and build configuration.

findings.title: Raw source evidence cannot be verified on the deployed instance
findings.detail: All four saved alert payload hashes match, but verify_artifacts=true reports unavailable with missing_file for the referenced source files. These are missing bytes at the configured deployed locations, not proof of tampering. Package the public assets, verify SOURCE_ARTIFACT_DIR, and rerun the audit.

findings.title: Replay listing does not discover the saved replay runs
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/replays returns total=0 while GET /api/v1/runs?mode=replay returns four runs. The route filters on eligible replay_scenario metadata. Inspect the discovery metadata/query; use /runs?mode=replay for current run selection. Do not rewrite immutable evidence just to populate a dropdown.

findings.title: Business reads require a bearer token
findings.detail: All 13 business GET routes reject anonymous access with 401. This matches the production default and protects the API. If the research dashboard should be public, explicitly set PUBLIC_READS_ENABLED=true for reads and keep operator mutations authenticated. Never put the admin token in a public frontend.

findings.title: Tested browser origin is not allowed
findings.detail: An OPTIONS preflight for http://localhost:5173 with Authorization was rejected with 400. Same-origin Swagger works; configure CORS_ORIGINS with the actual approved frontend origin before browser integration. Other origins were not tested.
